Schedule a consultation CLIENT RESULT CONTACT BOOK NOW $ 0.00 0 Cart BOOK NOW A Different Approach to Medical Aesthetics Choosing where to go for aesthetic treatments is personal. It’s not just about the result, it’s about how you’re treated along the way. At Roddy MedSpa, we lead with hospitality. We take the time to understand your goals, answer your questions, and guide you toward what truly makes sense for you. No sales goals. No pressure. Just education. Behind that experience is deep clinical expertise. Our providers each bring over a decade of experience, allowing us to guide patients with confidence and care. Our founder, Renata Roddy, NP, is an Allergan Medical Institute Trainer, trusted to teach other injectors how to safely and effectively perform treatments like Botox and fillers, and the creator of Modern Beauty Con, one of the country’s leading medical aesthetics conferences. She also serves as Co-President of AMP MA, helping guide medical aesthetics standards and legislation in Massachusetts. What matters most is how that expertise shows up for you. Thoughtful. Personalized. Unrushed. Love The Way You Look We don’t take the responsibility of treating your face lightly. That’s why we’re highly trained, refresh our training annually, and throw the industry’s leading medical aesthetics conference. When you come to Roddy MedSpa, you can expect personalized treatment and natural-looking results from a team of experts. Featured Partnerships & Recognitions At Roddy MedSpa, we believe in delivering exceptional results — and that commitment to excellence has earned us recognition across the beauty, medical, and business communities. Official MedSpa of the New England Patriots Cheerleaders Roddy MedSpa is proud to be the official skincare sponsor of the New England Patriots Cheerleaders from 2021-2026. For five seasons, we helped the cheerleaders keep their glow game strong with customized facials and education on healthy skincare habits using ZO Skin Health. Official MedSpa of Miss Massachusetts USA & Miss Massachusetts Teen USA Since 2021, we have been honored to partner with Miss Massachusetts USA and Miss Massachusetts Teen USA to help each delegate prepare for the national Miss USA and Miss Teen USA stages. From flawless skin to confidence-boosting self-care routines, we ensure each woman shines from the inside out. Distinguished Woman Award – WALC Conference Founder Renata Roddy was nominated for the Distinguished Woman Award at the prestigious WALC (Women’s Advanced Leadership Conference), recognizing her impact in business, aesthetics, and community leadership. iHeartRadio’s “CEOs You Should Know” Feature Roddy MedSpa was featured on iHeartRadio’s “CEOs You Should Know,” a segment spotlighting innovative leaders shaping the future of their industries. Renata’s interview shared the journey of building Roddy MedSpa and empowering clients through self-confidence and expert care. North Shore Magazine Feature Renata was also proudly featured in Northshore Magazine highlighting her as an standout provider in medical aesthetics and showcasing her dedication to client results and continuing education. Best In Pageantry Awards Meet Our Team Renata Roddy FNP-BC, Owner Grace Healy Esthetician Jessica Mitchell AGAC NP-C Steven Roddy CEO Niki Murray Patient Coordinator Our Core Values 01 Safety Your safety is our priority. It’s that simple. Rest assured knowing that we put this above all else at Roddy. 02 Training We take training seriously, it’s why we throw the industry’s leading medical aesthetics conference each year. 03 Personalization Everyone’s face, skin, and body are different. We believe personalizing every person’s treatment is crucial to providing the best possible results. 04 Results We want you to walk out our door feeling confident and excited to see the image staring back at you in the mirror. Want a little guidance? Schedule a consultation. We learn about your areas of concern, goals, age, activity level, diet, and more. By getting to know you, we can provide a personalized treatment plan. Schedule a consultation Results Resources Cherry Beauty Bank Client Portal Contact Privacy Policy Cancellation Policy 781-627-7070 Monday 9 am–4 pm Tuesday 9 am–7 pm Wednesday 9 am–7 pm Thursday 9 am–7 pm Friday 9 am–4 pm Saturday 9 am–3 pm Sunday Closed © 2022 – Roddy MedSpa – Love the Way You Look 491 Maple St, Suite 208 (Building 200), Danvers, MA 01923 Niki Murray, Patient Coordinator , RN Niki Murray brings a warm, compassionate, and client-focused approach to her work, with a background in hospitality, wellness, and administrative support. Originally from Marblehead, Massachusetts, she previously worked in luxury spa management in Nashville before returning to the North Shore. Niki is known for her strong communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to help clients feel comfortable, supported, and cared for. With experience coordinating schedules, managing client relationships, and creating positive experiences, she values professionalism, kindness, and genuine human connection in every aspect of her work. Outside of work, Niki is a certified Reiki practitioner who enjoys wellness practices, mindfulness, long walks by the ocean, and spending time with family and her local community Jessica Mitchell, Injector , RN Jessie is an APRN with a strong clinical and entrepreneurial background. She has 15 years of Emergency Room experience and 14 years of specialized expertise in medical aesthetics. Her career reflects a unique blend of advanced medical knowledge, precision-based aesthetic treatments, and prior business ownership. She is highly proficient in injectables, laser technologies, radiofrequency microneedling (RFMN), chemical peels, HydraFacial treatments, and a wide range of advanced aesthetic services. Known for a meticulous, safety-first approach and natural-looking results, she prioritizes patient education, individualized treatment planning, and evidence-based care. She combines clinical excellence with strategic leadership, delivering high-quality aesthetic outcomes while fostering trust, innovation, and long-term patient relationships. Grace Healy, Medical Esthetician , RN Grace is a medical esthetician working in the profession of skin and beauty since 2001. During her career as a makeup artist, Grace fell in love with all things related to skin and skin care. She attended Catherine Hinds School of Esthetics, earning her certification in 2015. She later went on to receive another certification in Laser Technology from the National Laser Institute in Dallas, Texas. Grace has a passion for enhancing natural beauty and creating beautiful and youthful skin. Grace creates healthy skin with a flawless glowing finish, and enjoys teaching her clients how to care for and maintain their skin. She believes in a nurturing experience with great results. Steven Roddy, CEO , RN Steven Roddy is the co-founder of Roddy MedSpa, where his focus is making every patient feel like a VIP. With a background in entrepreneurship and brand building, Steven has helped shape Roddy MedSpa into more than just a place for treatments—it’s an experience built on the philosophy that hospitality is our best treatment. Alongside his wife, Renata Roddy, NP, Steven has introduced innovative systems like the Beauty Blueprint™ consultation framework and Beauty Bank. These tools are designed to simplify patient care, create consistency, and ensure that every visit is welcoming, personalized, and results-driven. Renata Roddy FNP-BC, OWNER With more than 10 years in the medical field, Renata Roddy, owner of Roddy MedSpa, brings deep expertise and a thoughtful, results-driven approach to aesthetic care. A Boston College graduate, Renata began her career as an OB Nurse at Mass General while completing her Master’s degree to become a Nurse Practitioner. After graduation, she worked as a Family Nurse Practitioner in an outpatient clinic before following her ultimate passion: aesthetics. Today, Renata is not only a sought-after provider but also an AMI (Allergan Medical Institute) trainer, trusted to educate other injectors on advanced, safe injection techniques. Renata is also the founder of Modern Beauty Con —a nationally recognized medical aesthetics conference where top injectors and industry leaders gather to share knowledge, sharpen skills, and shape the future of the field. Her background in fitness competitions and pageantry—including winning Miss Massachusetts United States 2014—further informs her balanced, holistic approach to beauty and wellness. If you’re looking to fall in love with the way you look, Renata’s clinical expertise, artistic eye, and commitment to education make her one of the most trusted injectors in the industry. Alana Goyetche Master Esthetician Alana, a licensed Esthetician, completed the Accelerated Advanced Program at the Catherine Hinds Institute of Esthetics in 2020, marking the start of her journey in the world of skincare. Her initial experience at a Danvers, MA spa illuminated her passion for advanced skincare treatments, propelling her toward her current role at Roddy MedSpa. Remaining committed to staying updated with the latest products, techniques, and technology, Alana ensures her clients receive the best possible care. Her primary goal is to create a nurturing environment where clients feel comfortable and confident in their skin, delivering both visible results and a serene, relaxing experience. With over 4 years dedicated to skincare, Alana has developed expertise in various specialized treatments, such as custom facials, chemical peels, and dermaplaning. Her talent lies in tailoring treatment plans to meet each client's unique skincare needs, emphasizing personalized care and attention. Her aim is to create a soothing and personalized spa experience by blending her skills with a warm and inviting demeanor. Manage Consent We value your privacy.
